[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in the Korean-Style Doenjang Jjigae and requested a simple recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for Doenjang Jjigae with the following ingredients:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 tablespoons doenjang (Korean fermented soybean paste)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 tablespoons gochujang (Korean chili paste)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 cloves garlic, minced  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 small onion, diced  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 cups vegetable broth (or anchovy broth for added umami)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup diced zucchini  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup diced carrots  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup diced potatoes  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup diced Korean chili flakes (gochugaru) or red pepper flakes (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Salt and black pepper, to taste
